content.text: {"headline":"Approve R1: overtime and chat deflection on both queues, plus callback on General, lifts service level to 80.9% for 11:00–15:15 at ₹6,648.","why":"General has been running 34–51% above forecast since 10:15. Service level fell to 24.6% at 10:45, with 22 abandoned calls. Staffing and handle time are on plan, so the cause is extra demand, and that demand is still unexplained. R1 is the cheapest plan that reaches the 80% target over the disruption window (80.9% overall). It delays breaks on both queues by 30 minutes and offers overtime to 8 General agents (11:30–15:00) and 6 Payments agents (12:30–14:30). It also turns on 20% chat deflection for balance and payment-status enquiries and IVR callback on General. Predicted abandon rate drops from 6.9% to 3.7%, and rest-of-day service level rises to 85.6%.","trade_offs":["Cost: R1 costs ₹6,648, about double the next-best P4 (₹3,396). P4 reaches only 75.2% and misses target. R2 reaches 88.1% but costs ₹8,982, which is ₹2,334 more than R1.","Queue balance: General is still below target at 76.3% even under R1. The plan reaches 80% overall partly because Payments rises to 84.9%. Only R2 gets General above 80% (85.3%).","Payments risk: the no-cost plan P1 actually drops Payments to 67.6% and lowers overall service level to 63.8%, which is worse than doing nothing (65.6%). R1 protects Payments with its own overtime rather than drawing agents from it during the day.","Overtime uptake: R1 depends on 14 agents accepting overtime. If fewer accept, results will fall toward P4's levels."],"watch":"Watch General's service level and call volume each interval after 11:30. If overtime uptake is short or General stays well under 76%, consider stepping up to R2. Separately, check with IT whether customer login is having problems. login_issue calls are running at 1.76x forecast with no incident ticket, and a hidden outage could keep demand high beyond 15:15."}
